fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. v0.37.5 finalizes OCum Ascended support after the v0.37.4 proxy diagnostic: RaceMenu CumOverlays remain synchronized between players, but OCum's 3D vaginal and anal equip-object meshes are intentionally not synchronized because OStim reports them as equipped on the remote STR proxy while the proxy never renders the mesh. The unsupported 3D object traffic is suppressed; local OCum rendering, texture overlays, PPA, scene anchors and alignment are unchanged.
